title: 12-Week Strength Development Program
description: Progressive strength training program with three mesocycles focusing on foundation, strength, and power integration
trainingMaxNote: Use 95% of true 1RM for TM calculations

steps.name: Activation

steps.name: Easy Movement

exercises.name: Quads

steps.name: Light Cardio

mesocycles.title: Foundation & Technique
mesocycles.phaseFocus: Learn movement patterns, build joint stability, establish baseline strength

microcycle.title: Upper Body

exercises.name: Light Cardio
exercises.instruction: Row, bike, or light jog to elevate heart rate
exercises.definition: Raises core temperature and prepares cardiovascular system
exercises.notes: Easy pace to elevate heart rate and body temperature. Should feel comfortable, not challenging.

exercises.name: Arm Circles
exercises.instruction: Start small and gradually increase circle size.

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls
exercises.instruction: Roll shoulders in a smooth circular motion.

exercises.name: Scapular Wall Slides
exercises.instruction: Back against wall; keep elbows/wrists on wall and slide up/down.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotations (Quadruped)
exercises.instruction: On hands and knees, hand behind head, rotate elbow up.
exercises.definition: Thoracic mobility for pressing and pulling

exercises.name: Band Pull-Aparts
exercises.instruction: Band at chest height; pull apart until shoulder blades squeeze.

exercises.name: Neck Rolls
exercises.instruction: Slow circular motion with head, moving through comfortable range of motion
exercises.definition: Neck mobility exercise to relieve tension in cervical spine and upper trapezius muscles
exercises.notes: Stay relaxed, avoid forcing range. Move slowly and smoothly through each direction.

exercises.name: Scap Push-Ups
exercises.instruction: Hands under shoulders; protract then retract scapulae without bending elbows.

exercises.name: Band External Rotations
exercises.instruction: Elbow at side; rotate forearm outward against light band.
exercises.definition: Rotator cuff activation for pressing health

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instruction: Opposite arm/leg extend; keep low back pressed down.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.notes: Focus on form and controlled tempo
exercises.instruction: Lie on bench, retract shoulder blades, lower bar to lower chest, press to full lockout

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Full range of motion, controlled eccentric
exercises.instruction: Pull bar to upper chest, squeeze lats, control return

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Keep ribs down, press overhead without arching
exercises.instruction: Sit on bench with back support, holding dumbbells at shoulder height. Press weights overhead by extending arms, keeping core tight and ribs down. Lower with control.
exercises.definition: Upper body pushing exercise targeting shoulders and triceps while seated for stability

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Neutral spine, pull to hip
exercises.instruction: Bend over with one knee on bench, pull dumbbell to hip

exercises.name: Biceps Curl
exercises.notes: Keep elbows at sides, curl to full contraction, control descent.
exercises.instruction: Keep elbows at sides, curl weight to full biceps contraction, lower with control

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.notes: Arms overhead, extend to full lockout, control return.
exercises.instruction: Arms overhead, extend weight to full lockout, control return

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.instruction: Forearm on doorway; rotate torso away.

exercises.name: Triceps + Lat Stretch
exercises.instruction: Arm overhead, elbow bent; gentle side lean.
exercises.definition: Lat and triceps length after pulling/pressing

exercises.name: Upper Back Foam Roll
exercises.instruction: Roll mid-back only; support head.

exercises.name: Lat Foam Roll
exercises.instruction: Side-lying; roll armpit to mid-rib.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.instruction: Inhale 4, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4.

microcycle.sessionIntent: DUP stimulus today: strength focus — controlled heavy sets within target RPE; no junk volume. DUP: primary strength exposure.

exercises.name: Light Jog/Bike
exercises.notes: 60% HRmax
exercises.instruction: Very easy movement to promote blood flow. Should feel effortless and restorative.

exercises.name: Sun Salutations
exercises.notes: Match breath to movement throughout
exercises.instruction:
Begin in Mountain Pose (Tadasana): Stand tall, feet together, arms at sides, weight evenly distributed
INHALE: Sweep arms overhead, slight backbend, gaze up (Urdhva Hastasana)
EXHALE: Hinge at hips, fold forward, hands to floor or shins (Uttanasana)
INHALE: Lift chest halfway, flat back, fingertips on shins or floor (Ardha Uttanasana)
EXHALE: Step or jump back to Plank, lower through Chaturanga (elbows tight to ribs)
INHALE: Press through hands, lift chest into Upward Dog (Urdhva Mukha Svanasana)
EXHALE: Lift hips, press back into Downward Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana) - hold 5 breaths
Step or jump feet to hands, INHALE lift halfway, EXHALE fold
INHALE: Rise to standing, arms overhead, EXHALE: hands to heart center
Repeat sequence 5 times, finding a smooth rhythm
exercises.definition: Dynamic stretching sequence that improves flexibility, balance, and body awareness.

exercises.name: Downward Dog to Pigeon Pose
exercises.notes: Square hips, fold forward, breathe into hip stretch
exercises.instruction:
From Downward Dog, lift right leg high
Bring right knee forward behind right wrist
Right shin can be parallel to front of mat (more advanced) or angled back toward left hip (modification)
Extend left leg straight back, top of foot on floor
Square hips toward front of mat—use a block under right hip if needed
Walk hands forward, fold chest toward floor
Hold for 2 minutes, breathing deeply into the hip
Press back to Downward Dog, shake out legs, repeat on left side
exercises.definition: Dynamic stretching sequence that improves flexibility, balance, and body awareness.

exercises.name: Warrior I → Warrior II → Reverse Warrior
exercises.notes: Strong legs, open hips, flow with breath
exercises.instruction:
WARRIOR I: Step right foot forward into lunge, back foot angled 45°, hips squared forward, arms overhead, gaze up. Hold 30s.
WARRIOR II: Open hips and arms to side, back foot turns to 90°, front knee over ankle, arms parallel to floor, gaze over front fingers. Hold 30s.
REVERSE WARRIOR: Keep legs as is, flip front palm up, reach back and up, back hand slides down back leg, side body opens. Hold 30s.
Flow back through Warrior II to Warrior I
Step back to Mountain Pose, repeat entire sequence on left side
Maintain steady ujjayi breath throughout
exercises.definition: Dynamic stretching sequence that improves flexibility, balance, and body awareness.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.notes: Initiate movement from pelvis, articulate through entire spine
exercises.instruction:
Start on hands and knees: wrists under shoulders, knees under hips
COW (Inhale): Tilt pelvis forward, drop belly, lift chest and gaze, shoulder blades draw together
CAT (Exhale): Tilt pelvis back, round spine toward ceiling, tuck chin, push floor away
Move slowly—feel each vertebra articulate
Let the breath initiate the movement, not the other way around
Continue for 10 full cycles
exercises.definition: Dynamic stretching sequence that improves flexibility, balance, and body awareness.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.notes: Full surrender, deep belly breaths
exercises.instruction:
From hands and knees, sit hips back toward heels
Knees can be together (more back stretch) or wide apart (more hip stretch)
Walk arms forward, forehead rests on floor (or on stacked hands)
Let shoulders melt down away from ears
Breathe into your lower back and sides of ribcage
This is complete rest—let go of all tension
exercises.definition: Dynamic stretching sequence that improves flexibility, balance, and body awareness.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold
exercises.notes: Hinge from hips, not from lower back
exercises.instruction:
Sit with legs extended straight in front
Flex feet (toes point toward ceiling)
Inhale, lengthen spine, reach arms overhead
Exhale, hinge at hips (not waist), reach toward feet
Hold whatever you can reach: thighs, shins, ankles, or feet
Keep back as flat as possible—it's okay if knees bend slightly
Relax head and neck, breathe deeply
exercises.definition: Dynamic stretching sequence that improves flexibility, balance, and body awareness.

exercises.name: Savasana (Corpse Pose)
exercises.notes: Complete stillness and surrender
exercises.instruction:
Lie flat on back, legs extended, feet fall open naturally
Arms at sides, palms facing up
Close eyes, release all muscular effort
Scan body for tension and consciously release it
Breathe naturally, observe without controlling
This is integration time—let the practice settle in
exercises.definition: Dynamic stretching sequence that improves flexibility, balance, and body awareness.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.instruction: Slow nasal box breathing to finish.
exercises.definition: Final nervous-system downshift after restorative flow

microcycle.title: Lower Body

exercises.name: Light Cardio
exercises.instruction: Bike, row, or light jog to raise heart rate
exercises.definition: Prepares cardiovascular system for lower body work
exercises.notes: Easy pace to elevate heart rate and body temperature. Should feel comfortable, not challenging.

exercises.name: Leg Swings (Front-to-Back)
exercises.instruction: Stand tall holding a wall. Swing one leg forward and back in a controlled arc.
exercises.definition: Dynamic hip flexor and hamstring preparation

exercises.name: Leg Swings (Side-to-Side)
exercises.instruction: Swing leg across the body and out to the side with hips square.

exercises.name: Hip Circles
exercises.instruction: Lift knee to 90° and draw large circles outward then inward.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.instruction: Deep lunge, hand to floor, elbow toward instep, rotate chest up.
exercises.definition: Hip flexor, groin, and thoracic prep

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat + Reach
exercises.instruction: Squat with heels down; reach arms overhead at the bottom.
exercises.definition: Ankle, hip, and thoracic extension prep

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.instruction: Opposite arm/leg reach; keep hips level.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Soft knees, hinge at hips, maintain neutral spine
exercises.instruction: Hinge at hips with slight knee bend, lower bar while keeping back neutral, return to standing

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Hips stacked, ribs down
exercises.instruction: Stack feet and hips, elbow under shoulder. Drive hips up and hold. Keep ribs down and breathe steadily.
exercises.definition: Lateral core stability exercise targeting obliques and hip stabilizers.

exercises.name: Step-Ups (low box)
exercises.notes: Focus on control and stability. Use light dumbbells (10-20 lbs) as you progress.
exercises.instruction: Stand facing low box or platform holding light dumbbells (10-20 lbs suggested, adjust as needed). Step up with one foot, driving through heel to lift body up. Step down with control. Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side. Enter weight used for tracking.
exercises.definition: Unilateral lower body exercise targeting quadriceps and glutes while improving single-leg stability

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Full hip extension, squeeze glutes at top. Progress by adding resistance band around thighs or across hips.
exercises.instruction: Lie on back with knees bent, feet flat on floor. Optional: Place resistance band around thighs (just above knees) or across hips for added resistance. Drive through heels to lift hips up, squeezing glutes at top. Lower with control.
exercises.definition: Hip extension exercise targeting glutes and hamstrings. Can be performed bodyweight or with resistance band for progression.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.notes: Push through the ball of the foot, pause at the top, control the lowering phase.
exercises.instruction: Stand with feet hip-width apart, optionally holding weights. Rise up onto balls of feet by pushing through toes. Pause at top, then lower with control.
exercises.definition: Isolation exercise targeting calf muscles (gastrocnemius and soleus)

exercises.name: Piriformis Stretch (Figure Four)
exercises.instruction: Ankle over knee; pull thigh toward chest.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.instruction: Half-kneeling; tuck pelvis and lean forward.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.instruction: Long-spine hinge stretch.

exercises.name: Foam Roll – Quads
exercises.instruction: Slow rolls hip to knee.

exercises.name: Child Pose Breathing
exercises.instruction: Long nasal exhales.

exercises.name: Run Intervals
exercises.notes: Sustain pace during fast intervals
exercises.instruction: Run at a challenging pace for 1 minute, then walk for 2 minutes. Focus on consistent effort each interval.
exercises.definition: Interval training to build aerobic capacity and improve running economy.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swings
exercises.notes: Hinge at hips, drive through heels, snap hips forward, let KB float to chest height
exercises.instruction: Stand with feet shoulder-width, hold KB with both hands. Hinge at hips, drive hips forward explosively, swing KB to chest height. Control the descent.
exercises.definition: Full-body power exercise developing hip drive, posterior chain strength, and cardiovascular conditioning.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Hold KB at chest, keep chest tall, push knees out, sit between hips
exercises.instruction: Hold KB vertically at chest with both hands. Keep chest tall, push knees out, sit down between your hips, drive through heels to stand.
exercises.definition: Lower body strength exercise targeting quads, glutes, and core stability.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Press
exercises.notes: Press from rack position, keep core tight, press up and slightly back
exercises.instruction: Hold KB at shoulder in rack position. Keep ribs down, press KB up and slightly back until arm is fully extended. Control the descent.
exercises.definition: Upper body pressing exercise developing shoulder strength and stability.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Row
exercises.notes: Row to hip, squeeze shoulder blades, avoid rotating torso
exercises.instruction: Bend over with one knee on bench, hold KB in opposite hand. Pull KB to hip, squeeze shoulder blade, control the descent.
exercises.definition: Upper body pulling exercise targeting lats, rhomboids, and rear delts.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Farmer's Walk
exercises.notes: Stay tall, ribs down, walk with controlled steps, maintain grip
exercises.instruction: Hold KBs at your sides. Walk with tall posture, keeping ribs stacked over hips. Maintain smooth, controlled steps.
exercises.definition: Loaded carry exercise developing grip strength, core stability, and full-body conditioning.

exercises.name: Scap Push-Ups
exercises.instruction: Hands under shoulders; protract then retract scapulae without bending elbows.

exercises.name: Band External Rotations
exercises.instruction: Elbow at side; rotate forearm outward against light band.
exercises.definition: Rotator cuff activation for pressing health

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.instruction: Opposite arm/leg extend; keep low back pressed down.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Keep chest tall, push knees out, sit between hips, stay balanced mid‑foot.
exercises.instruction: Perform Goblet Squat with controlled quality and full range.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Keep wrists stacked over elbows, lower with control, avoid flaring elbows.
exercises.instruction: Perform Incline Dumbbell Press with controlled quality and full range.

exercises.name: Pull-Ups
exercises.notes: Full range of motion, pull to chest, control descent.
exercises.instruction: Hang from bar, pull body up until chin over bar, lower with control

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Keep hips square, hinge from hips, maintain soft knee bend.
exercises.instruction: Perform Single-leg Romanian Deadlift with controlled quality and full range.

exercises.name: Farmer's Carry
exercises.notes: Stay tall, ribs down, walk with controlled steps, crush the handles.
exercises.instruction: Hold heavy weights at sides, walk with tall posture and stacked ribs. Challenge grip without compromising form.
exercises.definition: Loaded carry for grip strength, core stability, and conditioning.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.instruction: DUP secondary: explosive press, crisp lockout.
exercises.notes: DUP power: speed over load. Leave 3+ RIR.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.instruction: Forearm on doorway; rotate torso away.

exercises.name: Triceps + Lat Stretch
exercises.instruction: Arm overhead, elbow bent; gentle side lean.
exercises.definition: Lat and triceps length after pulling/pressing

exercises.name: Upper Back Foam Roll
exercises.instruction: Roll mid-back only; support head.

exercises.name: Lat Foam Roll
exercises.instruction: Side-lying; roll armpit to mid-rib.

exercises.name: Box Breathing
exercises.instruction: Inhale 4, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4.

microcycle.sessionIntent: DUP: secondary power/volume exposure for repeated lifts.

loadingPhilosophy.notes: Intensity progresses linearly within the block. Use target RPE and session readiness to autoregulate. Main-lift volume follows Prilepin-safe ranges.

appImplementation.autoCalcLoads: For exercises with percentTM: weight = percentTM × TM, round to nearest 2.5 lb
appImplementation.rpeGuardrails: If user logs RPE >8 on RPE 6-7 day, suggest reducing load by 2.5-5%

rpeGuardrails.description: Autoregulation targets aligned to Prilepin intensity zones
rpeGuardrails.rule: If readiness is low or bar speed dies, reduce load 5-10% rather than grinding. Never exceed Prilepin max total reps for the intensity zone.
